scripts.files: bun run tasks/tree-explorer/index.ts -e node_modules -e tmp -e .git -e .vscode -p -o tmp/files.json
scripts.lint: bun run join && bun run actions/lint/cli.ts . -o tmp/lint.md && cat tmp/join.md >> tmp/lint.md
scripts.edit-context: bun run join && cat tmp/join.md generator/bun/README.md actions/edit/edit.md > tmp/edit.md
scripts.commit: git add . && git diff --staged > tmp/diff.patch && bun run join && bun run actions/commit/cli.ts tmp/diff.patch -c tmp/join.md -o tmp/commit.md
